paper.path: paper_bencmark/reference_papers/P13_The numerical stability of barycentric Lagrange interpolation.pdf

source_locations.role: exact Lagrange representation and limiting supremum definition under componentwise data perturbations
exact closed-form condition-number identity, sign-aligned attainment, and lower bound

semantic_checks.name: source-selection
semantic_checks.requirement: The exact paper version, passage, and surrounding result are correct.

semantic_checks.name: binders-and-types
semantic_checks.requirement: Every binder, type, dimension, and index set has the intended meaning.

semantic_checks.name: quantifier-scope
semantic_checks.requirement: Quantifier order, scope, witness dependence, and Skolemization are preserved.

semantic_checks.name: hypotheses
semantic_checks.requirement: Explicit and implicit hypotheses match, including positivity and nonzero conditions.

semantic_checks.name: conclusion-completeness
semantic_checks.requirement: Every conclusion, conjunct, case, and dependency is present.

semantic_checks.name: operators-and-definitions
semantic_checks.requirement: Every nontrivial operator and imported definition has been unfolded and interpreted.

semantic_checks.name: exact-versus-computed
semantic_checks.requirement: Exact, rounded, perturbed, and computed quantities are not conflated.

semantic_checks.name: algorithm-linkage
semantic_checks.requirement: The statement remains linked to the paper's algorithm and execution model.

semantic_checks.name: norm-semantics
semantic_checks.requirement: Norm kind, squared versus unsquared form, and componentwise versus normwise meaning match.

semantic_checks.name: constants-and-indexing
semantic_checks.requirement: Constants, coefficients, index offsets, and parameter dependence match.

semantic_checks.name: floating-point-model
semantic_checks.requirement: Precision, rounding mode, exceptional values, underflow, and overflow assumptions match.

semantic_checks.name: relation-strength
semantic_checks.requirement: Equality/inequality direction, strictness, and logical strength are correct.

semantic_checks.name: error-notion
semantic_checks.requirement: Forward, backward, mixed, residual, and stability notions are not substituted for one another.

semantic_checks.name: higher-order-terms
semantic_checks.requirement: First-order approximations, exact remainders, and big-O terms are handled faithfully.

semantic_checks.name: specialization
semantic_checks.requirement: Finite, scalar, real, dimensional, or other specialization/generalization is classified correctly.

semantic_checks.name: nonvacuity
semantic_checks.requirement: The formal hypotheses are satisfiable and the conclusion is not true for an unintended trivial reason.
